::: {.callout-note .part-overview icon=false}
## Why this part comes here

Language is not a file transfer. Words are evidence from which another person infers meaning, intention, emotion, and relationship. Communication improves when people replace confident mind-reading with partner-centered attention, responsive questions, visible listening, and repair.
:::

## Guiding questions

- Which level of conversation is each person trying to have?
- What am I guessing that I could ask?
- How can understanding become observable?
- How can honesty remain warm enough to be usable?
